Referral-graph admission: every identity hangs from a verified referral chain, so a fake is never a standalone vertex but an inspectable node.

Each referrer locks 100 for 12 epochs, at most 3 endorsements per epoch. Density above 0.6 or a star cluster triggers review, mirroring real growth.

1,000 clones need 34 referrers locking 3,400; at 40% detection the loss hits 13,600, and each dawn re-checks the graph, so forgery cannot age into trust.
